recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, full-body portrait of a seated woman holding a large albino alligator across her lap, set against a textured dark forest-green wall and a patterned oriental rug.
coreVisualRelationships: The pale, textured skin of the alligator contrasts sharply against the dark green background.
The subject's direct gaze creates a formal, confrontational engagement with the viewer.
The horizontal line of the alligator bisects the verticality of the seated figure.
The warm wood of the chair and the intricate rug ground the surreal subject matter in a domestic setting.
coreInvariants: Presence of a large, pale reptilian creature
Direct eye contact from the central figure
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subject's presence

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered horizontally, occupying the middle and lower thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The head of the albino alligator serves as the primary focal point due to its high value contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Viewer starts at the alligator's head, follows its body across the lap, moves up to the woman's face, and then down to the detailed rug.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark green negative space in the top half of the frame creates a sense of weight and atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark forest green (background) provides a moody, atmospheric base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/Cream (alligator and shirt) creates high-value focal points.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earth tones (rug and chair) provide warmth and complexity.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background allows the high-value subject to pop; deep shadows provide depth.

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a black rectangular box

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family condensed sans-serif for utilitarian clarity.
graphicDevices: Solid black rectangular container for text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel.
Provides a similar grotesque sans-serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman seated in an Art Deco wooden chair, holding a large albino alligator across her lap. The background is a dark, textured forest-green wall. The floor is covered by a detailed, worn Persian rug. Lighting is soft but directional from the side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small black rectangular box in the bottom-left corner. Inside the box, center-align white, bold, condensed sans-serif text in three stacked rows.

verificationChecks: Is the alligator's texture visible and pale?
Is the background a deep, moody green?
Is the text box positioned in the lower-left corner?
Does the subject maintain a direct gaze?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the green background texture
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: High contrast between the pale reptile and dark background
Rich, painterly texture in the green wall

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the alligator looks like a physical object in the scene, not a flat overlay.
Check that the lighting on the subject matches the lighting on the reptile.
Verify the rug texture is sharp and detailed.
Confirm the text box does not obscure critical visual elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central figure + high-contrast surreal animal + dark textured backdrop + grounding domestic elements (rug/chair).
